terms.name: Attempt
terms.definition: What the risk service is told about a login it is asked to judge: the user id, once the credentials have been checked.

terms.name: Authenticate
terms.definition: Check an email address and a password and answer with a user id or one refusal.

terms.name: Bus
terms.definition: What the relay hands an event to once it is out of the outbox, and what a policy subscribes to. One per domain, in-process today.

terms.name: Conflict
terms.definition: The copy of an aggregate in hand is not what is stored; somebody wrote it since it was read.

terms.name: Credential
terms.definition: An email address and a password, presented together.

terms.name: Email address
terms.definition: The address a user logs in with, normalised and validated on creation.

terms.name: Expiry
terms.definition: The moment a session stops being usable because of time.

terms.name: Locked
terms.definition: The state of a lockout while it refuses. Read off the time; nothing runs when it ends.

terms.name: Lockout
terms.definition: An account refusing passwords for a while after too many wrong ones in a row: five, for fifteen minutes. One per user, from the first wrong password on.

terms.name: Login
terms.definition: Turn a credential into a session: authenticate, ask risk, start.

terms.name: Logout
terms.definition: End the session behind a token, at the user's request. Reason `logout`.

terms.name: Outbox
terms.definition: The table a domain event is written to in the same transaction as the change it describes, and read back out of by the relay - every topic of it, whether or not anything listens.

terms.name: Password hash
terms.definition: What is stored in place of a password: algorithm, cost, salt and digest.

terms.name: Password policy
terms.definition: The rules a new password must satisfy. Applies when a password is created, never when one is checked.

terms.name: Policy
terms.definition: A rule of the form "when this fact happened, do that", spanning two aggregates: revoke sessions on password change. Subscribed to the bus by assembly.

terms.name: Reason
terms.definition: Why a session ended: `logout`, `revoked`, `password-changed`, `risk-blocked`. A closed set.

terms.name: Refusal
terms.definition: The one answer every failed credential check gets: malformed address, unknown address, wrong password, locked account.

terms.name: Register
terms.definition: Create a user from a credential.

terms.name: Revoke
terms.definition: End a session deliberately, with a reason. Terminal; a revoked session never comes back.

terms.name: Risk
terms.definition: The service asked whether a login attempt should go ahead.

terms.name: Session
terms.definition: Proof that a user logged in, how long that proof is good for, and whether it has been taken away.

terms.name: Threshold
terms.definition: The number of wrong passwords in a row that locks an account. One value for everybody.

terms.name: Token
terms.definition: The opaque string a client presents instead of a credential. Carries no claims.

terms.name: User
terms.definition: A person as this context knows them: an id, an email address and a password hash.

terms.name: Validate
terms.definition: Resolve a token to a live session: who is calling and until when. Reads only.

terms.name: Verdict
terms.definition: Risk's answer, in this context's words: `allow` or `block`.

terms.name: Version
terms.definition: The number the store compares before writing an aggregate. Zero means never stored.
